autopilot.first_setup_desc: Market Signal Lab needs the shared Envato API token once on this Windows account. The token is verified before it is stored securely.
autopilot.network_unavailable_desc: Envato could not be reached. Check the network connection and try again; the saved credential has not been removed.
autopilot.credential_store_desc: Windows could not access the saved Envato credential. Restart Market Signal Lab or contact your administrator; your market history is unchanged.
autopilot.provider_response_desc: Envato returned an unexpected response. The saved credential and local history were preserved.
autopilot.observe_uses_saved_credential: Official API lane. The configured Envato credential is resolved by the local Go application and is never included in this browser request.
autopilot.source_settings_desc: Enter the shared Envato token once. Market Signal Lab verifies it and stores it in Windows Credential Manager for this researcher account.
autopilot.uses_settings_token: Uses the saved Envato credential from Settings.
autopilot.schedule_note: Headless mapping uses the configured credential or an explicit environment override.
autopilot.first_run_desc: Connect Envato in Settings once, then map the observed market. The first map shows composition only; direction requires comparable history.
